results.title: The Next Olympics Location: Every Host City Through 2032
results.content: In an unusual move, the IOC awarded the sprawling southern California city the 2028 Summer Olympics at the same time as it announced Paris’s winning 2024 bid, against which Los Angeles had been contending. The L.A. organizers have so far promised a “fiscally prudent Games” that will serve up “enduring benefits to the host city and the Olympic Movement.” L.A. has hosted an Olympics twice before for the summer games, first in 1932 and then again in 1984. Many of the city’s preexisting structures [...] Paris is no stranger to the summer Olympics, having hosted back in 1900 and exactly one century before its upcoming games, in 1924. The French metropolis bested other minor European candidates and its major opponent, Los Angeles, to host the 2024 Olympics. According to early statements, Paris will use 95% “existing or temporary venues” with “a clear, defined legacy” in order to avert the post-Olympics malaise that cities like Athens have sometimes suffered. The new Olympic Village is expected [...] will be spread out across “clusters,” with Milan hosting the opening ceremony, figure skating and ice hockey, many skiing events happening in the Valtellina area, more skiing and sports like luge in Cortina, cross country and speed skating in Val di Fiemme and the closing ceremony ending the 2026 Games in Verona.
